_note: Manual metric overrides, keyed by slug. Wins over synced at render time (precedence: override > synced > provisional; overlays never carry metrics, so there is no authored tier). check-drift.js NEVER writes this file on `drift sync`; it reads it only to flag stale baselines, and writes it only on the explicit `bun run drift:keep`, which refreshes an existing entry's baseline; it does not create new entries, so the first entry for a field must be hand-written. Per field: value = what is shown; syncedWhenSet = the synced value at the moment the override was set, or null for a pure pin with no baseline to flag; syncedField = the underlying synced field to compare against (defaults to the field name; only `commitsHeadline` ever needs this, e.g. `commitsMe` for a team project). The drift report flags a field when current synced !== syncedWhenSet. Run `bun run drift:keep -- <slug> <field>` to refresh the baseline and dismiss the flag while keeping your manual value.
